claims: The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion officially releases on Friday, May 22, 2026.
Prerelease events for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion will run from May 9 through May 17, 2026.
Prerelease events for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion offer early access to Build & Battle boxes.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion features over 120 cards.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion focuses on Mega Evolution Pokémon ex.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion includes Mega Greninja ex.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion includes Mega Pyroar ex.
Elite Trainer Box is a key product for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion.
